---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

data("billboard", package = "tidyr")

billboard_long <- billboard |>
	pivot_longer(
		cols = starts_with("wk"),
		names_to = "week",
		names_prefix = "wk",
		names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
		values_to = "rank",
		values_drop_na = TRUE
	) |>
	mutate(song = str_c(track, " - ", artist))

featured_songs <- billboard_long |>
	count(song, name = "weeks_on_chart") |>
	slice_max(weeks_on_chart, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) |>
	pull(song)

billboard_long |>
	filter(song %in% featured_songs) |>
	ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, color = song)) +
	geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.9) +
	scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
	scale_y_reverse(
		breaks = c(1, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100),
		limits = c(100, 1)
	) +
	scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
	labs(
		title = "How hit songs move through the Hot 100",
		subtitle = "Weekly rankings for the eight longest-charting songs",
		x = "Week on chart",
		y = "Billboard Hot 100 rank",
		color = NULL
	) +
	theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
	theme(
		legend.position = "bottom",
		legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
		panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
	) +
	guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
```
